examples.en: In an immense caldron soup was boiling; and rabbits and hares were being roasted on a spit.
examples.zh: 锅里的汤正在沸腾；兔子和野兔被放在烤叉上烤。

examples.en: The Canada lynx shows a ten-year cycle of abundance that parallels the abundance cycle of hares.
examples.zh: 加拿大猞猁的丰饶周期为10年，与野兔的丰饶周期相似。

examples.en: I could swear I remembered seeing rabbits in the snow a couple of times, I means hares, that were brown.
examples.zh: 但是我能发誓我记得有几次在雪地里看到过兔子，我是说野兔，棕色的那种。
